product_metadata.title: LOFE Adjustable Memory Foam Pillow - 4 Heights from 1.2'' to 4.8'', Cervical Pillow for Neck Pain, Neck Support for Back, Stomach, Side Sleepers, Includes a Bamboo Pillowcase, Medium Firm
features: UNIQUE 4 HEIGHTS SUIT ALL SLEEPERS: Our neck pillow has four layers to customize your own pillow. You can customize 4 different combinations of layers which create four heights such as 1.2'', 2.4'', 3.6'' and 4.8''. Try to find ''just right'' position to relieve your neck or back pain whatever you are stomach sleepers, side sleepers or back sleepers.

WHY SHOULD YOU CHOOSE OUR PILLOW: Don't settle for too soft foam providing no support. We use premium medium firm memory foam certified by CertiPUR-US, which provides superior support for your neck and head. It is durable and safe. Say goodbye to neck pain.

INNER PILLOWCASE FOR LONGER SERVICE LIFE: Each layer of memory foam is equipped with an inner pillowcase, which can protect the memory foam from being torn while adjusting the side sleeper pillow. It is very convenient to adjust the memory foam neck pillow with the inner case. It can prevent memory foam layers from sticking together.

BAMBOO MACHINE WASHABLE COVER: Included is a removable and machine washable bamboo cover. This super soft material is hypoallergenic and breathable which can wick away moisture and help you feel not too hot. Our neck support pillow has ventilation holes to help alleviate excessive heat build-up.

EXPLANATION OF MEMORY FOAM'S ODOR: When you open the package, the pillow may still have a "foamy " smell because we packaged it quickly after producing. Our memory foam is certified by CertiPUR-US. Using the pillow directly is not harmful. If you really mind it, You can take the pillow core out of the pillowcase and let it air out for 2 days or wash the pillowcase. This smell will fade away.
